name: Rockwell Automation

eyebrow.en: Rockwell Automation, Inc. · Common stock · Milwaukee, Wisconsin
eyebrow.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 · 普通股 · 威斯康星州密尔沃基

title.en: Factory automation, pulled along by chip fabs and data centers.
title.zh: 工厂自动化，由晶圆厂与数据中心拉动。

lede.en: Rockwell sells the controllers, drives, sensors and software that run factories, warehouses and process plants. After a two-year industrial slump, organic sales grew 10% last quarter on semiconductor, data center and warehouse projects, and the full-year outlook was raised. It is a slower, steadier story than the chip names on this site, priced at about 33 times this year's earnings.
lede.zh: 罗克韦尔销售运行工厂、仓库和流程工厂的控制器、驱动器、传感器和软件。经历两年工业低迷后，上季在半导体、数据中心和仓储项目带动下有机销售增长 10%，全年展望上调。相比本站的芯片股，这是一个更慢、更稳的故事，估值约为今年盈利的 33 倍。

s.zh: 调整后每股指引中值 $13.15 · 预期约 29 倍

s.en: Q4 FY26 and FY27 outlook · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY26 第四季及 FY27 展望 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Rockwell has closed between about $400 and $495 since May.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。罗克韦尔自5月以来收盘价在约 $400 至 $495 之间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Rockwell's fiscal year ends September 30. Gross margin steps up from about 40% to about 48% in FY25 in the source data, and the two fiscal Q4 figures are left blank because the source shows outliers. The last bar is the Q4 sales implied by the ~$9.0B full-year guide.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。罗克韦尔财年于9月30日结束。数据源中毛利率在 FY25 由约 40% 升至约 48%，两个财年第四季数字因数据源异常而留空。最后一根柱为约 90 亿美元全年指引所隐含的 Q4 销售。

p.en: Semiconductor fabs, data centers and warehouse automation drove the quarter, with automotive and life sciences improving.
p.zh: 半导体工厂、数据中心与仓储自动化带动本季增长，汽车与生命科学亦在改善。

p.en: Segment operating margin rose to 22.3% from 19.5%, and Software & Control earns nearly 35%.
p.zh: 分部营业利润率由 19.5% 升至 22.3%，软件与控制业务利润率近 35%。

p.en: The November report brings the first FY27 guide. The market will look for organic growth to hold near this year's 7.5–9.5%.
p.zh: 11月财报将首次给出 FY27 指引。市场将关注有机增长能否维持今年 7.5–9.5% 的水平。

p.en: Organic annual recurring revenue grew 6% and software ARR high single digits, a slower but steadier part of the mix.
p.zh: 有机年度经常性收入增长 6%，软件 ARR 增长接近一成，是增长较慢但较稳定的部分。

p.en: Rockwell's sales fell from $2.56B to $1.88B a quarter during the 2024 destocking. A turn in capex budgets would hit orders quickly.
p.zh: 2024 年去库存期间，罗克韦尔季度销售由 25.6 亿美元降至 18.8 亿。资本开支预算一旦转向，订单会迅速受影响。

p.en: At about 33 times this year's adjusted EPS, the stock already prices in a solid recovery.
p.zh: 按今年调整后每股收益计约 33 倍，股价已反映稳健复苏。

p.en: Full-year results and the first FY27 outlook. The FY26 guide implies about $2.34B of Q4 sales.
p.zh: 全年业绩及首份 FY27 展望。FY26 指引隐含 Q4 销售约 23.4 亿美元。

p.en: Rockwell has raised its dividend every November for many years; the current rate is $1.38 a quarter.
p.zh: 罗克韦尔多年来每年11月上调股息，目前每季 $1.38。

p.en: First quarter of the new fiscal year, usually the seasonal low.
p.zh: 新财年首季，通常为季节性低点。

sources: Q3 FY26 summary and guidance (Stock Titan)
Price, market cap, beta and analyst targets: Yahoo Finance and Stocklake, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Rockwell Automation, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Rockwell Automation, Inc. 无关联。

guide: 2026年9月 · 由约 90 亿全年指引推算

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 FY21 to Q3 FY26. Rockwell's fiscal year ends September 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY21 第四季至 FY26 第三季共 20 个季度。罗克韦尔财年于9月30日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Rockwell's free cash flow is seasonal: the December quarter is usually the weakest (it was negative in Q1 FY22 and Q1 FY24) and the second half is strongest. Q3 FY26 produced a record $654M, and the last four quarters add up to about $1.5B.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自由现金流有季节性：12月季度通常最弱（FY22 和 FY24 第一季为负），下半财年最强。FY26 第三季创下 6.54 亿美元纪录，近四季合计约 15 亿。

read.en: My base case uses the ~$9.0B FY26 sales guide (about $2.34B in Q4) and keeps the recent seasonal pattern, with modest growth into FY27. That gives about $1.6B over four quarters. The main risk is the industrial cycle: in FY24, when customers cut inventory, quarterly free cash flow fell as low as −$35M.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用约 90 亿美元的 FY26 销售指引（Q4 约 23.4 亿），沿用近期的季节性模式，FY27 小幅增长，四季合计约 16 亿美元。主要风险是工业周期：FY24 客户去库存时，季度自由现金流一度低至 −3,500 万美元。

p.en: About $155M a quarter at $1.38 per share, usually raised each November.
p.zh: 每股 $1.38，每季约 1.55 亿美元，通常每年11月上调。

p.en: $754M of repurchases over the first three quarters of FY26, including $446M in Q2.
p.zh: FY26 前三季回购 7.54 亿美元，其中 Q2 4.46 亿。

p.en: About $3.6B of debt against $479M of cash, so buybacks partly depend on borrowing.
p.zh: 债务约 36 亿美元，现金 4.79 亿，因此回购部分依赖借款。

p.en: Organic sales grew 10% in Q3 after the 2024 destocking.
p.zh: 继 2024 年去库存后，Q3 有机销售增长 10%。

p.en: Segment margin of 22.3% means more of each sales dollar becomes cash.
p.zh: 分部利润率 22.3%，意味着每一美元销售转化为更多现金。

p.en: Dissolving the Sensia joint venture removed a lower-margin business in the second half of FY26.
p.zh: 解散 Sensia 合资企业，于 FY26 下半年剥离了一项较低利润率的业务。

bridgeNote.en: Rockwell runs with little cash and funds part of its buybacks with debt, so cash on hand rarely builds up.
bridgeNote.zh: 罗克韦尔现金较少，部分回购以债务融资，因此账面现金很少累积。
